title: Kelvo worker on Oracle E2.1.Micro: bounded b09f2da rerun
scope: Worker-only accounting. Azure gateway, three NATS brokers, ClickHouse source, and all SSH tunnel processes are excluded. Incomplete matched campaigns do not satisfy five-pair capacity acceptance and must not be combined with another runtime.

host.machine_scope: Oracle VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro: fractional CPU allocation; visible logical CPUs are not dedicated cores

conditions.transport: separate pinned-key SSH control, source and result connections
conditions.cache_state: warm and uncontrolled; independent reference preparation precedes profiles
conditions.competing_work: Other bounded Azure Go checks and acceptance work ran during this campaign; Oracle fractional CPU allocation, burst capacity and host steal vary.

deadline_gate.message: not enough of the original authorized lifetime remains for a bounded profile and cleanup
